tools.name: get_us_exports_by_state
tools.description: Official U.S. Census Bureau export statistics for one U.S. state or territory (origin of movement): total exports for the last full year and year to date, rank among states, and the top destination countries and products.

tools.name: get_us_export_markets
tools.description: Official U.S. Census Bureau statistics for one product at the HS 4-digit level: total U.S. exports, the top destination countries with year-to-date change, and the states that ship the most.

tools.name: find_us_exporters
tools.description: Search the Fromerica directory of U.S. manufacturers and exporters by product. If no company is listed yet, returns the link where an importer can post a free request for quote that is shown to matching U.S. suppliers. Companies on the paid Pro plan are listed first and marked paid_placement=true.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_us_exporters · Private data: find_schedule_b · Public sink: find_us_exporters.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_us_exporters · Private data: find_schedule_b · Public sink: find_us_exporters

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_restricted_party" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
